description: This file defines the implementation of the AuthTokenHelper interface, providing methods to create and validate JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for authentication purposes in the Eclipse Hono project. It includes factory methods for different signing configurations and methods to create tokens with user authorities and to expand (validate) tokens.

classes.name: AuthTokenHelperImpl
classes.description: Implementation of AuthTokenHelper that provides methods to create and validate JWT tokens, extending JwtHelper with additional logic specific to Hono's authorization setup.

methods.name: forSigning
methods.description: Creates an AuthTokenHelper for signing JWTs with provided configuration and Vertx instance.

methods.name: forValidating
methods.description: Creates an AuthTokenHelper for validating JWTs with provided configuration and Vertx instance.

methods.name: forSharedSecret
methods.description: Creates an AuthTokenHelper that uses a shared secret for signing and validation, with token expiration configuration.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with the given authorization ID and authorities, setting issuer, subject, expiration, and authority claims.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Parses and validates a JWT token string, returning the claims if valid.
